hooks.command: hook_root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$hook_root" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$hook_root/hooks/sync_claude_session.py" || true; fi
hook_root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$hook_root" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$hook_root/hooks/sync_codex_session.py" || true; fi
hook_root="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$hook_root" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$hook_root/hooks/sync_grok_session.py" || true; fi
